title: Juicio quta thiyankir Ayllu
intro: Quta thiyankir mä ayllun jikxatasma, ukanx oladanakan ist’asitapax mä armat jaqinakan jisk’a arunakapampix mistu. Jupanakar samartʼapjjañapatakiw mä kamachi churapjjäna, ukampis qollqe munatapajj mä castigoruw puriyäna, uka castigojj jichhakamaw amuktʼat arunakampi parlapjje. ¿Khitinakäpjjänsa uk amuytʼasmati?
clues: Quta thiyan jakapxirïta ukat mä uru samartʼapxañajatakiw mä kamachi churapxitu.
Uka uruxa chawllanakax walpun jutapxirïtu, ukampis aptʼasiñ jarkʼapxitäna.
Jiwasat yaqhepajj jan jucha lurañat ewjjtʼapjjetäna, ukampis yaqhepajj kunjamatsa chawlla katuñatakiw mä amtar puripjjäna.
Qullan kamachi pʼakintasinxa, mä jachʼa mutuyäwi apanipxta.
Jiwasan castigox mä mayjt’äwiwa, ukax jan wali uñnaqt’ani ukat p’inqachataw jaytawayapxitu.
Monos ukar tukupjjayätwa, ukajj taqe khitinakatï qhepat jutapjjañapäkäna ukanakatak mä señalänwa.

location.label: Elemento Clave ukax mä juk’a pachanakanwa

arabic: وَسْـَٔلْهُمْ عَنِ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ ٱلَّتِى كَانَتْ حَاضِرَةَ ٱلْبَحْرِ إِذْ يَعْدُونَ فِى ٱلسَّبْتِ إِذْ تَأْتِيهِمْ حِيتَانُهُمْ يَوْمَ سَبْتِهِمْ شُرَّعًۭا وَيَوْمَ لَا يَسْبِتُونَ ۙ لَا تَأْتِيهِمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَبْلُوهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْسُقُونَ
verse: And ask them about the town that was by the sea - when they transgressed in [the matter of] the sabbath - when their fish came to them openly on their sabbath day, and the day they had no sabbath they did not come to them. Thus did We give them trial because they were defiantly disobedient. (7:163)
